create_ssh_environment: create an SSHEnvironment instance to run commands on a remote machine over SSH with ControlMaster connection reuse
build_ssh_command: build an SSH command list with ControlMaster, ControlPersist, BatchMode, and StrictHostKeyChecking options
establish_ssh_connection: establish an SSH connection to a remote host and verify it responds before proceeding
bulk_upload_files_over_ssh: bulk upload many files over SSH using a single tar pipe instead of per-file scp round-trips
run_bash_remote: run a bash command string on a remote host over SSH with optional login shell and timeout
